chapterInfo.content:
20
Yesu wusɔreɛ
(Mateo 28.1-10; Marko 16.1-11; Luka 24.1-12)
1Na da a ɛdi nnawɔtwe kan anɔpatutuutu a esum da so wɔ mu no, Maria Magdalene baa ɔboda no ho, na ɔbɛhunuu sɛ wɔayi ɔboɔ no afiri ɛda no ano. 2#Yoh 13.23 Ɛnna ɔtuu mmirika baa Simon Petro ne osuani baako a Yesu dɔ no no nkyɛn, na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Wɔayi Awurade afiri ɛda no mu, na yɛnnim faako a wɔde no akɔtoɔ. 3Ɛnna Petro ne osuani baako no firii adi baa ɛda no ho. 4Na wɔn baanu nyinaa tutuu mmirika, na osuani baako no yɛɛ ntɛm siane Petro ho, na ɔkɔduruu ɛda no ho kane. 5Na ɔbrɛɛ ne mu ase hwɛɛ mu no, n’ani bɔɔ nwera no so sɛ ɛgu hɔ deɛ, nanso wankɔ mu. 6Ɛnna Simon Petro dii n’akyiri baeɛ, na ɔkɔɔ ɛda no mu, na ɔhwɛɛ nwera a ɛgu hɔ no 7#Yoh 11.44 ne duku a wɔde bɔɔ ne tire nanso sɛ ɛngu nwera no ho, na mmom wɔabobɔ ɛno nkutoo da baabi no. 8Ɛno na afei osuani baako a ɔduruu ɛda no ho kane no nso hyɛnee mu, na ɔhunui, na ɔgye dii. 9#1 Ko 15.4; Aso 2.24-32 Na na wɔnnya nhunuu twerɛsɛm no, sɛ ɛtwa sɛ ɔsɔre firi awufoɔ mu no. 10Ɛnna asuafoɔ no sane baa wɔn fie bio.
Yesu yi ne ho adi kyerɛ Maria
11Na Maria deɛ, na ɔgyina ɔboda no ho resu. Ɛnna ɔresu no, ɔbɔɔ ne mu ase hwɛɛ ɛda no mu, 12na ɔhunuu abɔfoɔ a wɔhyɛ ntadeɛ fitaa sɛ wɔtete hɔ, ɔbaako te atifi, na ɔbaako te anafoɔ, faako a Yesu amu daeɛ hɔ. 13Na wɔbisaa no sɛ: Ɔbaa, adɛn na woresu? Ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Ɛfiri sɛ wɔafa me wura kɔ, na mennim faako a wɔde no akɔtoɔ.
14Na ɔkaa saa no, ɔdanee ne ho hwɛɛ n’akyi, na ɔhunuu Yesu sɛ ɔgyina hɔ, na na ɔnnim sɛ ɛyɛ Yesu. 15Yesu see no sɛ: Ɔbaa, adɛn na woresu? Worehwehwɛ hwan? Na ɔno deɛ, ɔsusuu sɛ ɛyɛ turom hɔ hwɛfoɔ nti, ɔsee no sɛ: Owura, sɛ woafa no afiri ha a, kyerɛ me faako a wode no akɔtoɔ, na menkɔfa no! 16Yesu see no sɛ: Maria! Na ɔdanee ne ho see no Hebri kasa mu sɛ: Raboni! (aseɛ ne sɛ: Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ). 17#Heb 2.11-12 Yesu see no sɛ: Mfa wo nsa nka me, na mennya menkɔɔ ɔsoro, m’Agya nkyɛn. Na kɔ me nuanom nkyɛn kɔka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ merebɛkɔ ɔsoro, m’Agya ne mo Agya ne me Nyankopɔn ne mo Nyankopɔn nkyɛn. 18Na Maria Magdalene ba bɛka kyerɛɛ asuafoɔ no sɛ: Mahunu Awurade; ne nsɛm a ɔka kyerɛɛ no no nyinaa.
Yesu yi ne ho adi kyerɛ n’asuafoɔ
(Marko 16.14-18; Luka 24.36-49)
19Ɛnna da a ɛdi nnawɔtwe kan no ara, ɛduruu anwummerɛ na Yudafoɔ ho hu nti wɔatoto apono mu faako a asuafoɔ no ahyia hɔ no, Yesu ba bɛgyinaa wɔn mfimfini, na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Asomdwoeɛ nka mo! 20#1 Yoh 1.1 Na ɔkaa saa no, ɔde ne nsa ne ne mfe mu kyerɛɛ wɔn. Na asuafoɔ no hunuu Awurade no, wɔn ani gyeeɛ. 21#Yoh 17.18 Ɛnna Yesu see wɔn bio sɛ: Asomdwoeɛ nka mo! Sɛdeɛ Agya no asoma me no, me nso mesoma mo. 22Na ɔkaa saa no, ɔhome guu wɔn so, na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Monnye Honhom Kronkron! 23#Mat 16.19; 18.18 Wɔn a mode wɔn bɔne kyɛ wɔn no, wɔde akyɛ wɔn; na wɔn a momma wɔn bɔne tena hɔ no, wɔama no atena hɔ.
Toma akyinnyegyeɛ
24 # Yoh 11.16; 14.5 Na Toma, dummienu no mu baako a wɔfrɛ no Ata no, nni wɔn mu na Yesu baeɛ. 25#Yoh 19.34 Ɛnna asuafoɔ no see no sɛ: Yɛahunu Awurade. Na Toma ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Sɛ manhunu ne nsam nnadewa no ananmu, na mamfa me nsateaa manka nnadewa no ananmu a, merennye menni.
26 # Yoh 20.19 Na ɛno akyiri nnawɔtwe, na n’asuafoɔ no wɔ ɛdan mu bio, na Toma ka wɔn ho. Na Yesu bae, nso na apono no mu atoto, na ɔbɛgyinaa wɔn mfimfini, na ɔkaa sɛ: Asomdwoeɛ nka mo! 27Ɛnna afei ɔsee Toma sɛ: Fa wo nsateaa bra ha na bɛhwɛ me nsamu, na fa wo nsa bɛka me mfe mu, na nyɛ okyinnyegyefoɔ, na gye di! 28#Yoh 1.1 Toma bua see no sɛ: M’Awurade ne me Nyankopɔn! 29#1 Pe 1.8 Yesu see no sɛ: Toma, sɛ woahu me nti na woagye adie. Nhyira ne wɔn a wɔnhunuiɛ, na wɔgye die.
Nwoma yi botaeɛ
30Na afei, nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ pii nso wɔ hɔ a Yesu yɛɛ no asuafoɔ no anim a wɔantwerɛ no nwoma yi mu. 31#1 Yoh 5.13 Na yeinom na wɔatwerɛ sɛ monnye nni sɛ Yesu ne Kristo no, Nyankopɔn Ba, na mogye di a, moanya nkwa ne din mu.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na da a ɛdi nnawɔtwe kan anɔpatutuutu a esum da so wɔ mu no, Maria Magdalene baa ɔboda no ho, na ɔbɛhunuu sɛ wɔayi ɔboɔ no afiri ɛda no ano. Ɛnna ɔtuu mmirika baa Simon Petro ne osuani baako a Yesu dɔ no no nkyɛn, na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Wɔayi Awurade afiri ɛda no mu, na yɛnnim faako a wɔde no akɔtoɔ. Ɛnna Petro ne osuani baako no firii adi baa ɛda no ho. Na wɔn baanu nyinaa tutuu mmirika, na osuani baako no yɛɛ ntɛm siane Petro ho, na ɔkɔduruu ɛda no ho kane. Na ɔbrɛɛ ne mu ase hwɛɛ mu no, n’ani bɔɔ nwera no so sɛ ɛgu hɔ deɛ, nanso wankɔ mu. Ɛnna Simon Petro dii n’akyiri baeɛ, na ɔkɔɔ ɛda no mu, na ɔhwɛɛ nwera a ɛgu hɔ no ne duku a wɔde bɔɔ ne tire nanso sɛ ɛngu nwera no ho, na mmom wɔabobɔ ɛno nkutoo da baabi no. Ɛno na afei osuani baako a ɔduruu ɛda no ho kane no nso hyɛnee mu, na ɔhunui, na ɔgye dii. Na na wɔnnya nhunuu twerɛsɛm no, sɛ ɛtwa sɛ ɔsɔre firi awufoɔ mu no. Ɛnna asuafoɔ no sane baa wɔn fie bio.

Na Maria deɛ, na ɔgyina ɔboda no ho resu. Ɛnna ɔresu no, ɔbɔɔ ne mu ase hwɛɛ ɛda no mu, na ɔhunuu abɔfoɔ a wɔhyɛ ntadeɛ fitaa sɛ wɔtete hɔ, ɔbaako te atifi, na ɔbaako te anafoɔ, faako a Yesu amu daeɛ hɔ. Na wɔbisaa no sɛ: Ɔbaa, adɛn na woresu? Ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Ɛfiri sɛ wɔafa me wura kɔ, na mennim faako a wɔde no akɔtoɔ.
Na ɔkaa saa no, ɔdanee ne ho hwɛɛ n’akyi, na ɔhunuu Yesu sɛ ɔgyina hɔ, na na ɔnnim sɛ ɛyɛ Yesu. Yesu see no sɛ: Ɔbaa, adɛn na woresu? Worehwehwɛ hwan? Na ɔno deɛ, ɔsusuu sɛ ɛyɛ turom hɔ hwɛfoɔ nti, ɔsee no sɛ: Owura, sɛ woafa no afiri ha a, kyerɛ me faako a wode no akɔtoɔ, na menkɔfa no! Yesu see no sɛ: Maria! Na ɔdanee ne ho see no Hebri kasa mu sɛ: Raboni! (aseɛ ne sɛ: Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ). Yesu see no sɛ: Mfa wo nsa nka me, na mennya menkɔɔ ɔsoro, m’Agya nkyɛn. Na kɔ me nuanom nkyɛn kɔka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ merebɛkɔ ɔsoro, m’Agya ne mo Agya ne me Nyankopɔn ne mo Nyankopɔn nkyɛn. Na Maria Magdalene ba bɛka kyerɛɛ asuafoɔ no sɛ: Mahunu Awurade; ne nsɛm a ɔka kyerɛɛ no no nyinaa.


Ɛnna da a ɛdi nnawɔtwe kan no ara, ɛduruu anwummerɛ na Yudafoɔ ho hu nti wɔatoto apono mu faako a asuafoɔ no ahyia hɔ no, Yesu ba bɛgyinaa wɔn mfimfini, na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Asomdwoeɛ nka mo! Na ɔkaa saa no, ɔde ne nsa ne ne mfe mu kyerɛɛ wɔn. Na asuafoɔ no hunuu Awurade no, wɔn ani gyeeɛ. Ɛnna Yesu see wɔn bio sɛ: Asomdwoeɛ nka mo! Sɛdeɛ Agya no asoma me no, me nso mesoma mo. Na ɔkaa saa no, ɔhome guu wɔn so, na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Monnye Honhom Kronkron! Wɔn a mode wɔn bɔne kyɛ wɔn no, wɔde akyɛ wɔn; na wɔn a momma wɔn bɔne tena hɔ no, wɔama no atena hɔ.

Na Toma, dummienu no mu baako a wɔfrɛ no Ata no, nni wɔn mu na Yesu baeɛ. Ɛnna asuafoɔ no see no sɛ: Yɛahunu Awurade. Na Toma ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Sɛ manhunu ne nsam nnadewa no ananmu, na mamfa me nsateaa manka nnadewa no ananmu a, merennye menni.
Na ɛno akyiri nnawɔtwe, na n’asuafoɔ no wɔ ɛdan mu bio, na Toma ka wɔn ho. Na Yesu bae, nso na apono no mu atoto, na ɔbɛgyinaa wɔn mfimfini, na ɔkaa sɛ: Asomdwoeɛ nka mo! Ɛnna afei ɔsee Toma sɛ: Fa wo nsateaa bra ha na bɛhwɛ me nsamu, na fa wo nsa bɛka me mfe mu, na nyɛ okyinnyegyefoɔ, na gye di! Toma bua see no sɛ: M’Awurade ne me Nyankopɔn! Yesu see no sɛ: Toma, sɛ woahu me nti na woagye adie. Nhyira ne wɔn a wɔnhunuiɛ, na wɔgye die.

Na afei, nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ pii nso wɔ hɔ a Yesu yɛɛ no asuafoɔ no anim a wɔantwerɛ no nwoma yi mu. Na yeinom na wɔatwerɛ sɛ monnye nni sɛ Yesu ne Kristo no, Nyankopɔn Ba, na mogye di a, moanya nkwa ne din mu.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
